text.en: Clients describe Amanda as an insightful and empathetic trainer who instantly puts both dogs and owners at ease. Reviewers emphasize her calm demeanour, clear explanations, and ability to give family members confidence when managing challenging canine behaviours at home.

Pet owners report rapid progress with loose lead walking, reliable crate training, and curbing persistent puppy biting. Clients also praise practical, structured strategies for managing resource guarding and reactivity, which helped restore household harmony.

Owners remark on Amanda's immediate soothing effect on dogs ranging from young Boston terrier and crossbreed puppies to elderly diabetic terriers. Her methods focus on positive reinforcement and genuine understanding of canine body language during every session.

q.en: Does Amanda assist with puppy crate and toilet training?

a.en: Yes, clients report that her early puppy training sessions quickly establish reliable crate and house training routines.

q.en: Can the trainer help with severe resource guarding issues?

a.en: Reviewers specifically highlight effective, positive strategies that resolved severe resource guarding and aggressive behaviour.

q.en: Are home visits and follow-up sessions provided?

a.en: Yes, dog owners note that Amanda conducts bespoke home consultations and provides helpful follow-up guidance as puppies grow.

q.en: Does Our Love For Dogs offer holiday boarding for clients?

a.en: Clients mention that Amanda has accommodated dogs for holiday stays, offering reassurance to families away from home.
